key: ???: There they were!
en: ???: There they were!

key: Zel: I saw them! For just a moment...
en: Zel: I saw them! For just a moment...
ja: ゼル: 見えたの! ほんの一瞬だけど……

key: Zel: We've been looking everywhere for you, Glaceon!
en: Zel: We've been looking everywhere for you, Glaceon!
ja: ゼル: ずっとあちこち探してたんだよ、グレイシア!

key: Come out!
en: Come out!
ja: 出てきて!

key: Come back to me!
en: Come back to me!
ja: わたしのところに戻ってきて!

key: Zel: Lumi, do you really think that's going to work?!
en: Zel: Lumi, do you really think that's going to work?!
ja: ゼル: ルミ、本当にそれでうまくいくと思ってるの?!

key: Zel: Indeed, if beckoning them were all that were necessary, we would not be in this predicament.
en: Zel: Indeed, if beckoning them were all that were necessary, we would not be in this predicament.
ja: ゼル: ええ、呼びかけるだけで済むなら、こんな窮地には陥っていないでしょうね。

key: Zel: Oh... You're right, of course...
en: Zel: Oh... You're right, of course...
ja: ゼル: あ……そうだよね、その通り……

key: I'm sorry, I wasn't thinking...
en: I'm sorry, I wasn't thinking...
ja: ごめん、何も考えてなかった……

key: I never think...
en: I never think...
ja: いつも何も考えてない……

key: I never, ever, ever, ever, ever, ever, ever, ever, thought...
en: I never, ever, ever, ever, ever, ever, ever, ever, thought...
ja: 一度だって、一度だって、一度だって、一度だって、考えたことなんてない……

key: Zel: But they came in and there's \PN!
en: Zel: But they came in and there's \PN!
ja: ゼル: でも、入ってきた――そこに\PNがいる!

key: Zel: \PN, are you here to ruin everything again?
en: Zel: \PN, are you here to ruin everything again?
ja: ゼル: \PN、また全部を台無しにしに来たの?

key: Zel: Why else would \PN have stolen them?
en: Zel: Why else would \PN have stolen them?
ja: ゼル: そうでなきゃ、\PNがあの子たちを奪う理由なんてないでしょ?

key: Zel: Those are OUR Pokémon!
en: Zel: Those are OUR Pokémon!
ja: ゼル: あれはわたしたちのポケモンなの!

key: Zel: We're the ones who cared for them!
en: Zel: We're the ones who cared for them!
ja: ゼル: 面倒を見てきたのはわたしたちなんだから!

key: Zel: Give them BACK!
en: Zel: Give them BACK!
ja: ゼル: 返してよ!

key: Give them back... Give them back...
en: Give them back... Give them back...
ja: 返して……返して……

key: You took them away... Why did you take them away?
en: You took them away... Why did you take them away?
ja: 奪っていった……どうして奪っていったの?

key: Do you have any idea how quiet it is without them?
en: Do you have any idea how quiet it is without them?
ja: あの子たちがいないと、どれだけ静かか分かる?

key: Do you?
en: Do you?
ja: 分かるの?

key: Do you? Do you? Do you?
en: Do you? Do you? Do you?
ja: 分かるの? 分かるの? 分かるの?

key: DO YOU?!
en: DO YOU?!
ja: 分かるのかーーー!?

key: BENNETT: I think that's enough, Zero.
en: BENNETT: I think that's enough, Zero.
ja: ベネット: もう十分だろう、ゼロ。

key: I could commend you on getting here once again despite the sleep effect, but that's hardly necessary.
en: I could commend you on getting here once again despite the sleep effect, but that's hardly necessary.
ja: 眠りの効果を受けながらも、またここまでたどり着いたことを褒めてやってもいいが、その必要もあるまい。

key: After all, you've never really known failure, have you?
en: After all, you've never really known failure, have you?
ja: 何しろ、お前は本当の意味での「失敗」というものを、知らないのだろう?

key: Maybe-- maybe-- you lose a battle or two.
en: Maybe-- maybe-- you lose a battle or two.
ja: せいぜい――せいぜい――勝負に一度や二度負ける程度だ。

key: But that's not failure. That's just a set back.
en: But that's not failure. That's just a set back.
ja: だがそれは失敗ではない。ただの足踏みにすぎない。

key: You always end up on top.
en: You always end up on top.
ja: お前はいつだって最後には勝つ。

key: And why?
en: And why?
ja: それはなぜか?

key: Is it your determination?
en: Is it your determination?
ja: お前の意志の強さゆえか?

key: Or is justice on your side?
en: Or is justice on your side?
ja: それとも正義がお前の味方だからか?

key: Or maybe it's just the bond you have with your Pokémon and friends.
en: Or maybe it's just the bond you have with your Pokémon and friends.
ja: あるいは、ポケモンや友人たちとのきずなというだけのことかもしれない。

key: But all of those things are just cliches to handwave the fact that in this world, some people are given the privilege to succeed and some are not.
en: But all of those things are just cliches to handwave the fact that in this world, some people are given the privilege to succeed and some are not.
ja: だがそんなものはすべて、この世界では成功する特権を与えられる者とそうでない者がいるという事実をごまかすための、ただの決まり文句にすぎない。

key: I am fortunate enough to have come into that privilege after having been denied it for years.
en: I am fortunate enough to have come into that privilege after having been denied it for years.
ja: 私は幸運にも、長年その特権を与えられなかった末に、ようやく手に入れることができた。

key: But you...
en: But you...
ja: だがお前は……

key: This is just how you've always been, ever since you got to Reborn, isn't it?
en: This is just how you've always been, ever since you got to Reborn, isn't it?
ja: リボーンに来た時からずっと、お前はそういう人間だった――そうだろう?

key: To whatever god you pray to, I hope you've paid your tithes,
en: To whatever god you pray to, I hope you've paid your tithes,
ja: お前がどんな神に祈りをささげているにせよ、その献金だけは済ませておいたことを願うよ、

key: Because I intend to test the limits of your fortune until they break.
en: Because I intend to test the limits of your fortune until they break.
ja: なぜなら私は、お前の幸運の限界を、それが砕けるまで試すつもりだからだ。

key: Zero.
en: Zero.
ja: ゼロ。

key: It's time for a reunion.
en: It's time for a reunion.
ja: 再会の時間だ。

key: Zel: Yes, yes... That's right...
en: Zel: Yes, yes... That's right...
ja: ゼル: そう、そうだよね……その通り……

key: You can see how it feels to have your friends ripped away too!
en: You can see how it feels to have your friends ripped away too!
ja: あんたも、友達を引き裂かれる気持ちってやつを味わえばいい!

key: HYPNO!
en: HYPNO!
ja: スリーパー!

key: Bring them out.
en: Bring them out.
ja: 連れてこい。

key: CAIN: ...
en: CAIN: ...
ja: カイン: ……

key: SHELLY: ...
en: SHELLY: ...
ja: シェリー: ……

key: Zel: They can't HEAR you anymore, \PN!
en: Zel: They can't HEAR you anymore, \PN!
ja: ゼル: もう\PNの声なんて、二人には聞こえないんだよ!

key: BENNETT: Not that you ever say much...
en: BENNETT: Not that you ever say much...
ja: ベネット: もっとも、お前は元々あまりしゃべらないがな……

key: Zel: How does it FEEL?!
en: Zel: How does it FEEL?!
ja: ゼル: どんな気分ーーー?!

key: BENNETT: Save the gloating for later, Zero. We're on a schedule here.
en: BENNETT: Save the gloating for later, Zero. We're on a schedule here.
ja: ベネット: 勝ち誇るのは後にしろ、ゼロ。こっちはスケジュールが詰まっているのでな。

key: The others should be coming shortly too, and we need to be ready.
en: The others should be coming shortly too, and we need to be ready.
ja: 他の者たちもじきに来るはずだ。準備をしておかねばならない。

key: It could get crowded in here... but that's fine for our purposes.
en: It could get crowded in here... but that's fine for our purposes.
ja: ここは混み合うことになるだろうが……こちらの目的には好都合だ。

key: After all, everyone who sets foot in here becomes a puppet for Hypno to play with.
en: After all, everyone who sets foot in here becomes a puppet for Hypno to play with.
ja: 何しろ、ここに足を踏み入れた者は皆、スリーパーの操り人形になるのだからな。

key: And it's all thanks to this one that it could happen.
en: And it's all thanks to this one that it could happen.
ja: そしてそれが可能になったのも、すべてこいつのおかげだ。

key: When she ran off from Calcenon, we seized the opportunity.
en: When she ran off from Calcenon, we seized the opportunity.
ja: 彼女がカルセノンから逃げ出した時、私たちはその機会をつかんだ。

key: And then others came to find her...
en: And then others came to find her...
ja: そして、彼女を探しに他の者たちがやってきた……

key: And others to find them...
en: And others to find them...
ja: さらに、その者たちを探しに、また別の者たちが……

key: And now here you are.
en: And now here you are.
ja: そして今、お前がここにいる。

key: Dominos just love to fall.
en: Dominos just love to fall.
ja: ドミノというのは、倒れるのが大好きなものだ。

key: You should try it sometime.
en: You should try it sometime.
ja: お前もいつか試してみるといい。

key: Like, now.
en: Like, now.
ja: たとえば、今とかな。

key: BENNETT: As expected.
en: BENNETT: As expected.
ja: ベネット: 予想通りだ。

key: In that case, Zero?
en: In that case, Zero?
ja: となると、ゼロ?

key: Zel: Heheheh... I've been looking forward to this for a long time.
en: Zel: Heheheh... I've been looking forward to this for a long time.
ja: ゼル: へへへ……これ、ずっと楽しみにしてたんだ。

key: Zel: But which one do we give up? Which?
en: Zel: But which one do we give up? Which?
ja: ゼル: でも、どっちを手放そうかな? どっち?

key: BENNETT: Let the girl go. Cain has opposed us more frequently.
en: BENNETT: Let the girl go. Cain has opposed us more frequently.
ja: ベネット: 女の方を解放しろ。カインの方が、より頻繁に私たちに反抗してきた。

key: Zel: Understood.
en: Zel: Understood.
ja: ゼル: 了解。

key: Zel: Good morning!
en: Zel: Good morning!
ja: ゼル: おはよう!

key: SHELLY: Uhm...
en: SHELLY: Uhm...
ja: シェリー: あの……

key: \PN?
en: \PN?
ja: \PN?

key: Zel: And good night,
en: Zel: And good night,
ja: ゼル: そして、おやすみなさい、

key: Zel: And sweet, sweet dreams, \PN.
en: Zel: And sweet, sweet dreams, \PN.
ja: ゼル: とびきり甘い夢を、\PN。

key: L--ht-! C-mer-s!
en: L--ht-! C-mer-s!
ja: ラ-ト! カ-ラ!

key: M-ke i- fif-y. -m n-t c-ming ho--
en: M-ke i- fif-y. -m n-t c-ming ho--
ja: 五-年にし-れ。家には-帰らな-――

key: Th-re -s n- -xcu-e f-r --is.
en: Th-re -s n- -xcu-e f-r --is.
ja: こ-には弁-の余地も-い。

key: Pl--se -e s-lent-
en: Pl--se -e s-lent-
ja: ど-か、お-かに――

key: T--re -s NO st-nding -p t- u- an-more!
en: T--re -s NO st-nding -p t- u- an-more!
ja: も-、わたした-に逆ら-ことなんて誰に-できな-!

key: W- w-ll tr--m-h -s a f-mily.
en: W- w-ll tr--m-h -s a f-mily.
ja: わたく-たちは、家-として打ち-つ。

key: L-st ti-e a -an a-ked m- th-t, -e -eft t-- -rena cr-ing.
en: L-st ti-e a -an a-ked m- th-t, -e -eft t-- -rena cr-ing.
ja: 前にそ-を聞い-きた男は、泣きなが-アリーナ-去ってい-たわ。

key: Pr-vide-ce, I s-spec--
en: Pr-vide-ce, I s-spec--
ja: おそ-くは、天の-剤だろう――

key: You wanted to feel that control.
en: You wanted to feel that control.
ja: その支配を、感じたかっただけだろう。

key: Th- -nd -f a mea-s -oes n-t -ake i-s m--ning -nd.
en: Th- -nd -f a mea-s -oes n-t -ake i-s m--ning -nd.
ja: 手段が終-ったからといって、その意-まで終わ-わけでは-い。

key: N-, th-s -s --e o-ly w-y!
en: N-, th-s -s --e o-ly w-y!
ja: いいえ、こ-しか道は-いの!

key: Th-s i- -y pu--ose!
en: Th-s i- -y pu--ose!
ja: こ-がわたしの使-なんだ-ら!

key: LIAR!
en: LIAR!
ja: うそつき!

key: I w-ll a-ways l-ve yo- mo-e -han s-e, or an-one el-e, -ver c-ul--
en: I w-ll a-ways l-ve yo- mo-e -han s-e, or an-one el-e, -ver c-ul--
ja: わたしは、あの-よりも、他の-よりも、ずっとあなたを愛して-るの――

key: GARDEVOIR: You know what it's time for~
en: GARDEVOIR: You know what it's time for~
ja: サーナイト: さあ、あの時間がやってきたわよ~

key: Lights! Cameras!
en: Lights! Cameras!
ja: ライト! カメラ!

key: Aaaaand dramaaaaa~
en: Aaaaand dramaaaaa~
ja: そしてぇ……ドラマぁ~

key: BENNETT: Quickly, give them to Volcarona.
en: BENNETT: Quickly, give them to Volcarona.
ja: ベネット: 急げ、ウルガモスに渡すんだ。

key: \PN handed over the Sapphire Bracelets!
en: \PN handed over the Sapphire Bracelets!
ja: \PNはサファイアのブレスレットを渡した!

key: GARDEVOIR: \PN!
en: GARDEVOIR: \PN!
ja: サーナイト: \PN!

key: We should have guessed it was you~
en: We should have guessed it was you~
ja: やっぱりあなただったのね~

key: BENNETT: Excellent work, Volcarona. Thank you.
en: BENNETT: Excellent work, Volcarona. Thank you.
ja: ベネット: よくやった、ウルガモス。感謝する。

key: RADOMUS: I suspect that that is not quite the \PN we know.
en: RADOMUS: I suspect that that is not quite the \PN we know.
ja: ラドマス: それは、私たちの知る\PNとは、少し違うようだな。

key: SERRA: Bennett!
en: SERRA: Bennett!
ja: セラ: ベネット!

key: BENNETT: Oh, for-- Mother?
en: BENNETT: Oh, for-- Mother?
ja: ベネット: おい、まさか――母上?

key: Why did you have to come here too?
en: Why did you have to come here too?
ja: どうして母上まで、ここに来る必要があったんですか?

key: SERRA: For you, obvio--
en: SERRA: For you, obvio--
ja: セラ: あなたのためよ、当然――

key: Your hair...
en: Your hair...
ja: その髪……

key: It looks... better.
en: It looks... better.
ja: ……前より、いい感じね。

key: BENNETT: I'm aware, Mother, thank you.
en: BENNETT: I'm aware, Mother, thank you.
ja: ベネット: 分かっています、母上、ありがとう。

key: Now, please go.
en: Now, please go.
ja: もう、行ってください。

key: I don't wish for you to get dragged into this.
en: I don't wish for you to get dragged into this.
ja: こんなことに巻き込まれてほしくないんです。

key: SERRA: You should've thought of that before you went and joined up with a terrorist organization.
en: SERRA: You should've thought of that before you went and joined up with a terrorist organization.
ja: セラ: それなら、テロ組織に加わる前に考えるべきだったわね。

key: BENNETT: Firstly, they're more of a religious organization than a terrorist one.
en: BENNETT: Firstly, they're more of a religious organization than a terrorist one.
ja: ベネット: まず第一に、彼らはテロ組織というより宗教組織です。

key: Secondly, I don't approve of everything they do; I'm just doing a few jobs for them until I've paid my dues.
en: Secondly, I don't approve of everything they do; I'm just doing a few jobs for them until I've paid my dues.
ja: 第二に、彼らのやることすべてに賛成しているわけではありません。借りを返し終えるまで、いくつか仕事をしているだけです。

key: SERRA: You'll be paying your dues for a while yet when we're out of here.
en: SERRA: You'll be paying your dues for a while yet when we're out of here.
ja: セラ: ここを出たら、しばらくの間、わたしへの借りを返してもらうわよ。

key: Come on, or you're grounded for the next forty-five years.
en: Come on, or you're grounded for the next forty-five years.
ja: さあ、来なさい。じゃないと、これから45年間、外出禁止よ。

key: BENNETT: Make it fifty. I'm not coming home.
en: BENNETT: Make it fifty. I'm not coming home.
ja: ベネット: 50年にしてください。家には帰りませんので。

key: You can't treat me like a child forever, Mother.
en: You can't treat me like a child forever, Mother.
ja: いつまでも子供扱いはできませんよ、母上。

key: Zero, what are the lights doing?
en: Zero, what are the lights doing?
ja: ゼロ、この照明はどうなっている?

key: Zel: It's just a momentary dip in the power.
en: Zel: It's just a momentary dip in the power.
ja: ゼル: ただの一瞬の電力低下だよ。

key: Zel: I, um, don't think it's anything to worry about?
en: Zel: I, um, don't think it's anything to worry about?
ja: ゼル: その、多分、心配するようなことじゃないと思う?

key: RADOMUS: You may not be a child, but are your actions truly becoming of an adult?
en: RADOMUS: You may not be a child, but are your actions truly becoming of an adult?
ja: ラドマス: 子供ではないのかもしれないが、お前の行動は本当に大人にふさわしいものかな?

key: BENNETT: My actions? I'm--
en: BENNETT: My actions? I'm--
ja: ベネット: 私の行動? 私は――

key: Sorry, I cannot for a second take you seriously with that ridiculous mask on.
en: Sorry, I cannot for a second take you seriously with that ridiculous mask on.
ja: すまないが、そのばかげた仮面をつけたお前を、一瞬たりとも真剣に受け止められない。

key: SERRA: I told him it was awful.
en: SERRA: I told him it was awful.
ja: セラ: ひどい仮面だって、わたしも言ったのよ。

key: RADOMUS: Not all hats are created equal, but that doesn't mean they deserve any less respect.
en: RADOMUS: Not all hats are created equal, but that doesn't mean they deserve any less respect.
ja: ラドマス: 帽子はすべて平等というわけではないが、だからといって敬意に値しないわけではない。

key: BENNETT: Mother, how do you manage to make every new boyfriend weirder than the last?
en: BENNETT: Mother, how do you manage to make every new boyfriend weirder than the last?
ja: ベネット: 母上、どうやったら新しい恋人が毎回前より変な人になるんですか?

key: SERRA: Don't get the wrong idea here...
en: SERRA: Don't get the wrong idea here...
ja: セラ: 誤解しないでちょうだい……

key: GARDEVOIR: Besides, you should already know that Master is vigorously taken!
en: GARDEVOIR: Besides, you should already know that Master is vigorously taken!
ja: サーナイト: それに、マスターにはもう決まった相手がいるって、とっくに知ってるはずでしょ!

key: SERRA: Do you have to phrase it like that?
en: SERRA: Do you have to phrase it like that?
ja: セラ: その言い方しかできないの?

key: BENNETT: It's been a while, Gardevoir.
en: BENNETT: It's been a while, Gardevoir.
ja: ベネット: 久しぶりだな、サーナイト。

key: GARDEVOIR: Not long enough, if you ask me!
en: GARDEVOIR: Not long enough, if you ask me!
ja: サーナイト: わたしに言わせれば、全然久しぶりじゃないけどね!

key: BENNETT: I don't fault you for feeling that way.
en: BENNETT: I don't fault you for feeling that way.
ja: ベネット: そう感じるのも無理はない。

key: Please understand that I am no longer the same person you once knew.
en: Please understand that I am no longer the same person you once knew.
ja: 私はもう、お前が知っていた頃の私とは違うのだと、理解してほしい。

key: I would much rather everyone let the past go, but I understand that won't be possible.
en: I would much rather everyone let the past go, but I understand that won't be possible.
ja: できればみんなに過去を水に流してほしいところだが、それが無理なことも分かっている。

key: Especially for you, Luna.
en: Especially for you, Luna.
ja: 特に、お前にはな、ルナ。

key: LUNA: I beg your pardon?
en: LUNA: I beg your pardon?
ja: ルナ: 何とおっしゃいましたか?

key: BENNETT: I offer my sincerest apologies for how I acted before, but you need not accept them.
en: BENNETT: I offer my sincerest apologies for how I acted before, but you need not accept them.
ja: ベネット: 以前の私の振る舞いについては、心から謝罪する。だが、受け入れる必要はない。

key: There would be little point in doing so anyway.
en: There would be little point in doing so anyway.
ja: どのみち、そうしたところで、あまり意味はないだろうからな。

key: I disrespected you by treating you as an object before a person.
en: I disrespected you by treating you as an object before a person.
ja: 私はお前を、人としてではなく物として扱い、敬意を欠いた。

key: There is no excuse for this.
en: There is no excuse for this.
ja: これに弁解の余地はない。

key: Zero, is the PULSE using too much power or something?
en: Zero, is the PULSE using too much power or something?
ja: ゼロ、PULSEが電力を使いすぎているのか何かか?

key: Zel: The energy readings appear to be within acceptable levels.
en: Zel: The energy readings appear to be within acceptable levels.
ja: ゼル: エネルギー値は許容範囲内みたい。

key: Zel: The stupid thing just keeps power cycling for some reason!
en: Zel: The stupid thing just keeps power cycling for some reason!
ja: ゼル: このバカな機械、なぜか電源が入り切りを繰り返してるだけ!

key: Zel: But, um, it doesn't seem to have interrupted its hypnosis, so please don't worry!
en: Zel: But, um, it doesn't seem to have interrupted its hypnosis, so please don't worry!
ja: ゼル: でも、その、催眠は途切れてないみたいだから、心配しないで!

key: Zel: We'll continue to analyze it.
en: Zel: We'll continue to analyze it.
ja: ゼル: 引き続き解析するよ。

key: Zel: So don't hesitate if you want us to use \PN to grind them into DUST!
en: Zel: So don't hesitate if you want us to use \PN to grind them into DUST!
ja: ゼル: だから、\PNを使ってあいつらをちり一つ残さず粉々にしたいなら、遠慮なく言って!

key: RADOMUS: That man seems mildly unwell.
en: RADOMUS: That man seems mildly unwell.
ja: ラドマス: あの男、少々具合が悪いようだな。

key: BENNETT: Zero, we only need to subdue them, not do anything drastic.
en: BENNETT: Zero, we only need to subdue them, not do anything drastic.
ja: ベネット: ゼロ、必要なのは制圧だけだ。過激なことをする必要はない。

key: Zel: Subdue them, huh?
en: Zel: Subdue them, huh?
ja: ゼル: 制圧、か。

key: Zel: Okay, \PN? Would you be so kind?
en: Zel: Okay, \PN? Would you be so kind?
ja: ゼル: よし、\PN? お願いできる?

key: BENNETT: Zero, that's not--
en: BENNETT: Zero, that's not--
ja: ベネット: ゼロ、それは違――

key: LUNA: So that's how it is.
en: LUNA: So that's how it is.
ja: ルナ: そういうことですのね。

key: SERRA: You have \PN hypnotized...
en: SERRA: You have \PN hypnotized...
ja: セラ: \PNを催眠にかけているのね……

key: GARDEVOIR: And that hideous PULSE back there is the source~
en: GARDEVOIR: And that hideous PULSE back there is the source~
ja: サーナイト: で、あの向こうの見苦しいPULSEが元凶ってわけね~

key: LUNA: Then there is only one thing we must do, is there not?
en: LUNA: Then there is only one thing we must do, is there not?
ja: ルナ: それでは、わたくしたちのすべきことは、ひとつしかありませんわね?

key: We must defeat \PN in order to free him.
en: We must defeat \PN in order to free him.
ja: 彼を解放するには、\PNを倒さなければなりません。

key: RADOMUS: They were wise to seize \PN as their defensive line, given that he has bested all of us at some point.
en: RADOMUS: They were wise to seize \PN as their defensive line, given that he has bested all of us at some point.
ja: ラドマス: \PNを防衛線として押さえたのは賢明だな。何しろ、これまでに私たち全員を打ち負かしたことのある相手なのだから。

key: We must defeat \PN in order to free her.
en: We must defeat \PN in order to free her.
ja: 彼女を解放するには、\PNを倒さなければなりません。

key: RADOMUS: They were wise to seize \PN as their defensive line, given that she has bested all of us at some point.
en: RADOMUS: They were wise to seize \PN as their defensive line, given that she has bested all of us at some point.
ja: ラドマス: \PNを防衛線として押さえたのは賢明だな。何しろ、これまでに私たち全員を打ち負かしたことのある相手なのだから。

key: We must defeat \PN in order to free them.
en: We must defeat \PN in order to free them.
ja: 彼らを解放するには、\PNを倒さなければなりません。

key: RADOMUS: They were wise to seize \PN as their defensive line, given that they have bested all of us at some point.
en: RADOMUS: They were wise to seize \PN as their defensive line, given that they have bested all of us at some point.
ja: ラドマス: \PNを防衛線として押さえたのは賢明だな。何しろ、これまでに私たち全員を打ち負かしたことのある相手なのだから。

key: GARDEVOIR: But not all of us together!
en: GARDEVOIR: But not all of us together!
ja: サーナイト: でも、みんなで一緒にってわけじゃないでしょ!

key: LUNA: Wait.
en: LUNA: Wait.
ja: ルナ: お待ちください。

key: LUNA: Master, there was something you wished to do, was there not?
en: LUNA: Master, there was something you wished to do, was there not?
ja: ルナ: マスター、何かなさりたいことがおありだったのでは?

key: Please allow me to begin.
en: Please allow me to begin.
ja: まずは、わたくしから始めさせてください。

key: BENNETT: Luna, you--
en: BENNETT: Luna, you--
ja: ベネット: ルナ、お前は――

key: LUNA: Please be silent.
en: LUNA: Please be silent.
ja: ルナ: どうか、お静かに。

key: You claim to have changed, and you have chosen your side.
en: You claim to have changed, and you have chosen your side.
ja: 変わったとおっしゃるのなら、そして、自らの立場をお選びになったのなら。

key: If you are genuine in your prior assertions, then do what it is you set out to do for yourself now.
en: If you are genuine in your prior assertions, then do what it is you set out to do for yourself now.
ja: 先ほどのお言葉が本心であるならば、今こそ、ご自身で成し遂げようとしていたことをなさってください。

key: BENNETT: ...
en: BENNETT: ...
ja: ベネット: ……

key: You mean that if I truly respect you as a person, I need not take pity on or spare you as an enemy.
en: You mean that if I truly respect you as a person, I need not take pity on or spare you as an enemy.
ja: つまり、私が本当にお前を一人の人間として尊重するなら、敵としてあわれみをかけたり、手加減したりする必要はない、ということか。

key: It was never my intention for it to come to this, but so be it.
en: It was never my intention for it to come to this, but so be it.
ja: こうなることは望んでいなかったが、それならそれでいい。

key: I will cut the ties myself.
en: I will cut the ties myself.
ja: 縁は、私自身の手で断ち切ろう。

key: \PN.
en: \PN.
ja: \PN。

key: Defeat Luna.
en: Defeat Luna.
ja: ルナを倒せ。

key: LUNA: So this is it...
en: LUNA: So this is it...
ja: ルナ: これが、その時ですのね……

key: But this was only the natural outcome.
en: But this was only the natural outcome.
ja: ですが、これは自然な成り行きにすぎません。

key: Zel: There is NO standing up to us anymore!
en: Zel: There is NO standing up to us anymore!
ja: ゼル: もう、わたしたちに逆らうことなんて誰にもできない!

key: With \PN on our side, we might as well be invincible!
en: With \PN on our side, we might as well be invincible!
ja: \PNが味方についてるんだから、こっちは無敵みたいなものよ!

key: LUNA: Are you so sure of that?
en: LUNA: Are you so sure of that?
ja: ルナ: 本当に、そうお思いですか?

key: After all, my only role here is to soften \PN enough for my parents to overcome.
en: After all, my only role here is to soften \PN enough for my parents to overcome.
ja: 結局のところ、わたくしの役目は、両親が打ち勝てる程度まで\PNを弱らせることだけですから。

key: We will triumph as a family.
en: We will triumph as a family.
ja: わたくしたちは、家族として打ち勝つのです。

key: LUNA: If you will?
en: LUNA: If you will?
ja: ルナ: よろしいですか?

key: GARDEVOIR: Don't worry, dear Luna~
en: GARDEVOIR: Don't worry, dear Luna~
ja: サーナイト: 心配ないわ、ルナちゃん~

key: Even through \PN, there's no way we'll lose to these creeps~
en: Even through \PN, there's no way we'll lose to these creeps~
ja: \PN相手でも、こんな連中に負けるわけないもの~

key: Right, Master?
en: Right, Master?
ja: ねえ、マスター?

key: RADOMUS: I suppose it's our turn after all.
en: RADOMUS: I suppose it's our turn after all.
ja: ラドマス: どうやら、私たちの番のようだな。

key: Miss Voclain, may I have the honor of this battle?
en: Miss Voclain, may I have the honor of this battle?
ja: ヴォクラン嬢、この戦いの栄誉を、私にいただけるかな?

key: SERRA: Last time a man asked me that, he left the arena crying.
en: SERRA: Last time a man asked me that, he left the arena crying.
ja: セラ: 前にそれを聞いてきた男は、泣きながらアリーナを去っていったわよ。

key: RADOMUS: That's a risk I'm interested in taking right now.
en: RADOMUS: That's a risk I'm interested in taking right now.
ja: ラドマス: 今の私は、その危険を冒す価値があると思っているのでね。

key: SERRA: Then let's hope you can satisfy.
en: SERRA: Then let's hope you can satisfy.
ja: セラ: なら、期待に応えられることを祈るわ。

key: BENNETT: Seriously, Mother?
en: BENNETT: Seriously, Mother?
ja: ベネット: 本気ですか、母上?

key: I'm going to be sick here.
en: I'm going to be sick here.
ja: ここで吐きそうになってきました。

key: And this situation is stacked.
en: And this situation is stacked.
ja: それに、この状況は分が悪すぎる。

key: \PN, use these!
en: \PN, use these!
ja: \PN、これを使え!

key: Bennett tossed \PN the Full Restores!
en: Bennett tossed \PN the Full Restores!
ja: ベネットは\PNにかいふくのくすりを投げ渡した!

key: BENNETT: And, Zero, please actually do something already.
en: BENNETT: And, Zero, please actually do something already.
ja: ベネット: それと、ゼロ、いい加減、何か本当に行動してくれ。

key: Zel: That's your cue, \PN!
en: Zel: That's your cue, \PN!
ja: ゼル: それが合図だよ、\PN!

key: Go GET THEM!
en: Go GET THEM!
ja: 行け、やっつけて!

key: SERRA: Just what is that Trainer made of...
en: SERRA: Just what is that Trainer made of...
ja: セラ: あのトレーナー、一体何でできてるのかしら……

key: RADOMUS: Providence, I suspect.
en: RADOMUS: Providence, I suspect.
ja: ラドマス: おそらくは、天の配剤だろう。

key: LUNA: I see... So in the end, it still hasn't been enough.
en: LUNA: I see... So in the end, it still hasn't been enough.
ja: ルナ: そうですか……結局、まだ足りなかったのですね。

key: BENNETT: \PN performs even better than I expected.
en: BENNETT: \PN performs even better than I expected.
ja: ベネット: \PNは、私が思っていたよりもはるかにやるようだな。

key: Perhaps I've underestimated that woman.
en: Perhaps I've underestimated that woman.
ja: あの女性を、少し甘く見ていたのかもしれない。

key: Zel: And it's all thanks to my PULSE!
en: Zel: And it's all thanks to my PULSE!
ja: ゼル: それも全部、わたしのPULSEのおかげだから!

key: Zel: Zero, do not forget that I was the one who did the work.
en: Zel: Zero, do not forget that I was the one who did the work.
ja: ゼル: ゼロ、働いたのはわたしだってこと、忘れないでよね。

key: Zel: But it's okay, you helped a lot too!
en: Zel: But it's okay, you helped a lot too!
ja: ゼル: でも大丈夫、あんたもすごく手伝ってくれたし!

key: BENNETT: And just what part of this are you proud of?
en: BENNETT: And just what part of this are you proud of?
ja: ベネット: 一体、これのどこに誇れる部分があるんだ?

key: None of this was necessary.
en: None of this was necessary.
ja: こんなことをする必要は、何ひとつなかったんだ。

key: You could have just put them to sleep from the start.
en: You could have just put them to sleep from the start.
ja: 最初から眠らせておけばよかっただけの話だ。

key: Zel: Well, this was helpful to test--
en: Zel: Well, this was helpful to test--
ja: ゼル: でも、これは試すのに役立っ――

key: BENNETT: Don't speak.
en: BENNETT: Don't speak.
ja: ベネット: 黙れ。

key: The only thing that's been tested is your willingness to indulge.
en: The only thing that's been tested is your willingness to indulge.
ja: 試されたのは、お前が自分の欲を甘やかす気があるかどうか、それだけだ。

key: Zel: I'm-- I'm sorry, I don't understand...
en: Zel: I'm-- I'm sorry, I don't understand...
ja: ゼル: ご、ごめん、よく分からな……

key: BENNETT: You've just been enjoying puppeting \PN around as an outlet for your frustrations with them.
en: BENNETT: You've just been enjoying puppeting \PN around as an outlet for your frustrations with them.
ja: ベネット: お前はただ、\PNへの鬱憤のはけ口として、操り人形のように振り回すのを楽しんでいただけだ。

key: Zel: That's--
en: Zel: That's--
ja: ゼル: それは――

key: BENNETT: Nothing is gained by battling now when we'll just put them to rest anyway.
en: BENNETT: Nothing is gained by battling now when we'll just put them to rest anyway.
ja: ベネット: どのみち眠らせるだけなら、今戦ったところで何も得るものはない。

key: Zel: But you said--
en: Zel: But you said--
ja: ゼル: でも、あんたが言ったのは――

key: BENNETT: I said to actually do something; not to waste time and jeopardize the PULSE's security in a 1-vs-2 scenario.
en: BENNETT: I said to actually do something; not to waste time and jeopardize the PULSE's security in a 1-vs-2 scenario.
ja: ベネット: 私が言ったのは何か行動しろということだ。1対2の状況で時間を無駄にし、PULSEの安全を危険にさらせとは言っていない。

key: I will take responsibility for the battle with Luna, but this fight served no other purpose than to stroke your own ego.
en: I will take responsibility for the battle with Luna, but this fight served no other purpose than to stroke your own ego.
ja: ルナとの戦いについては私が責任を持つが、この戦いは、お前自身の自尊心を満たす以外に何の意味もなかった。

key: Zel: I just wanted to make sure \PN was fully under control...
en: Zel: I just wanted to make sure \PN was fully under control...
ja: ゼル: ただ、\PNがちゃんと支配下にあるって確かめたかっただけで……

key: BENNETT: You wanted to feel that control.
en: BENNETT: You wanted to feel that control.
ja: ベネット: お前は、その支配を感じたかっただけなのだろう。

key: I assume because you've lacked autonomy over your own body for so long.
en: I assume because you've lacked autonomy over your own body for so long.
ja: おそらく、長い間自分自身の身体すら自由にできなかったからだろうな。

key: Am I wrong?
en: Am I wrong?
ja: 間違っているか?

key: Zel: ...
en: Zel: ...
ja: ゼル: ……

key: BENNETT: And I read your file.
en: BENNETT: And I read your file.
ja: ベネット: それに、お前の記録には目を通した。

key: You were just a grunt before joining with those girls, correct?
en: You were just a grunt before joining with those girls, correct?
ja: あの女たちと組む前は、ただの下っ端だったのだろう?

key: Not an effective one either.
en: Not an effective one either.
ja: しかも、大して有能でもなかった。

key: They were your only chance to stand out, which is why you cling to them even now.
en: They were your only chance to stand out, which is why you cling to them even now.
ja: あの二人こそが、お前が目立てる唯一の機会だった。だからこそ、今もしがみついているのだろう。

key: The kind of behavior you've demonstrated today exemplifies your incompetence.
en: The kind of behavior you've demonstrated today exemplifies your incompetence.
ja: 今日お前が見せたような振る舞いこそが、お前の無能さを何より物語っている。

key: You let your emotions get in the way of your outcome.
en: You let your emotions get in the way of your outcome.
ja: お前は感情を、結果の妨げにしてしまっている。

key: Until you learn to set ambitions aside and truly focus on your self and your goals, you will never change.
en: Until you learn to set ambitions aside and truly focus on your self and your goals, you will never change.
ja: 野心を脇に置き、自分自身と目標に真に向き合うことを学ばない限り、お前は決して変われない。

key: SERRA: Did that missionary teach you that?
en: SERRA: Did that missionary teach you that?
ja: セラ: それ、あの宣教師に教わったの?

key: BENNETT: No, Mother.
en: BENNETT: No, Mother.
ja: ベネット: いいえ、母上。

key: That man has done little more for me than place me in footsteps my feet are not fit to fill.
en: That man has done little more for me than place me in footsteps my feet are not fit to fill.
ja: あの男が私にしてくれたことといえば、私の足には合わない足跡を歩かせようとした、それくらいのものです。

key: Even now, I understand that I cannot hope to fully live up to the title of Elite Four.
en: Even now, I understand that I cannot hope to fully live up to the title of Elite Four.
ja: 今でも、四天王の名に完全にふさわしくなることなど望めないと理解しています。

key: In realizing this, I learned to step back and take a more serious approach to self-improvement.
en: In realizing this, I learned to step back and take a more serious approach to self-improvement.
ja: それを悟ったからこそ、一歩下がって、より真剣に自己改善に取り組むことを学びました。

key: I believe the results should speak for themselves.
en: I believe the results should speak for themselves.
ja: その結果は、おのずと物語っているはずです。

key: SERRA: The results don't speak louder than you still sitting on the wrong side of the coin.
en: SERRA: The results don't speak louder than you still sitting on the wrong side of the coin.
ja: セラ: あなたがまだコインの間違った側に座っているという事実より、雄弁な結果なんてないでしょうけど。

key: BENNETT: Is it wrong to return one's debts?
en: BENNETT: Is it wrong to return one's debts?
ja: ベネット: 借りを返すことの、どこが間違っているのですか?

key: RADOMUS: The end of a means does not make its meaning end.
en: RADOMUS: The end of a means does not make its meaning end.
ja: ラドマス: 手段が終わったからといって、その意味まで終わるわけではない。

key: Are you sure you are not running from your own choices?
en: Are you sure you are not running from your own choices?
ja: 自分自身の選択から逃げているだけではないと、本当に言い切れるかな?

key: BENNETT: Zero, this has dragged on for far too long already.
en: BENNETT: Zero, this has dragged on for far too long already.
ja: ベネット: ゼロ、これはもう十分すぎるほど長引いている。

key: If you truly want to make yourself useful, put them all to sleep already so we can move on.
en: If you truly want to make yourself useful, put them all to sleep already so we can move on.
ja: 本当に役に立ちたいなら、さっさと全員を眠らせて、先に進ませてくれ。

key: Got it...
en: Got it...
ja: 分かった……

key: You'll all be out of our way for good now.
en: You'll all be out of our way for good now.
ja: これで、お前たちは永久に邪魔にならなくなる。

key: GARDEVOIR: You won't...
en: GARDEVOIR: You won't...
ja: サーナイト: そんなこと、させない……

key: LUNA: Gardevoir?
en: LUNA: Gardevoir?
ja: ルナ: サーナイト?

key: You are already injured from that fight; there is no need to push yourself further.
en: You are already injured from that fight; there is no need to push yourself further.
ja: あなたはもうあの戦いで傷ついています。これ以上、無理をする必要はありません。

key: GARDEVOIR: They would put Master to sleep...
en: GARDEVOIR: They would put Master to sleep...
ja: サーナイト: あいつらは、マスターを眠らせようとしてる……

key: Toss him aside and never let him wake up again...
en: Toss him aside and never let him wake up again...
ja: 放り捨てて、二度と目覚めさせないつもりで……

key: Maybe dispose of him outright after what he did...
en: Maybe dispose of him outright after what he did...
ja: もしかしたら、あんなことをしたあとだもの、いっそ始末してしまうかも……

key: I'll...
en: I'll...
ja: わたしは……

key: GARDEVOIR: I'll never, ever let that happen!
en: GARDEVOIR: I'll never, ever let that happen!
ja: サーナイト: そんなこと、絶対に、絶対にさせない!

key: SERRA: What is she doing...
en: SERRA: What is she doing...
ja: セラ: あの子、何をするつもり……

key: LUNA: As you may know, Gardevoir are fiercely loyal to their Trainers.
en: LUNA: As you may know, Gardevoir are fiercely loyal to their Trainers.
ja: ルナ: ご存じかもしれませんが、サーナイトはトレーナーに対して、非常に強い忠誠心を持つのです。

key: It is said that they will do anything in their power to protect their Trainer,
en: It is said that they will do anything in their power to protect their Trainer,
ja: トレーナーを守るためなら、あらゆる力を尽くすと言われています。

key: Even if it costs them their own life.
en: Even if it costs them their own life.
ja: たとえ、それが自らの命を懸けることになろうとも。

key: RADOMUS: Gardevoir--
en: RADOMUS: Gardevoir--
ja: ラドマス: サーナイト――

key: GARDEVOIR: Don't try to stop me!
en: GARDEVOIR: Don't try to stop me!
ja: サーナイト: 止めないで!

key: This is what I need to do.
en: This is what I need to do.
ja: これは、わたしがやらなきゃいけないことなの。

key: For you.
en: For you.
ja: あなたのために。

key: RADOMUS: Rather than doing something dramatic-- though I know you are such a fan of that--
en: RADOMUS: Rather than doing something dramatic-- though I know you are such a fan of that--
ja: ラドマス: 何か芝居がかったことをする前に――お前がそういうのを好むのは知っているが――

key: Let us have faith in the world and our other companions.
en: Let us have faith in the world and our other companions.
ja: この世界と、他の仲間たちを信じようではないか。

key: GARDEVOIR: Who is left?!
en: GARDEVOIR: Who is left?!
ja: サーナイト: 他に誰が残ってるって言うの?!

key: Who can stop \PN?
en: Who can stop \PN?
ja: 誰が\PNを止められるの?

key: Who won't just be put to sleep?!
en: Who won't just be put to sleep?!
ja: 誰が、ただ眠らされずに済むって言うの?!

key: LUNA: Gardevoir, please...
en: LUNA: Gardevoir, please...
ja: ルナ: サーナイト、どうか……

key: GARDEVOIR: No, this is the only way!
en: GARDEVOIR: No, this is the only way!
ja: サーナイト: いいえ、これしか道はないの!

key: I'll destroy that machine altogether!
en: I'll destroy that machine altogether!
ja: あの機械を、根こそぎ破壊してやる!

key: This is my purpose!
en: This is my purpose!
ja: これがわたしの使命なんだから!

key: RADOMUS: This is not your--
en: RADOMUS: This is not your--
ja: ラドマス: それはお前の――

key: GARDEVOIR: Yes! It is!
en: GARDEVOIR: Yes! It is!
ja: サーナイト: ううん! そうなの!

key: To make sure you lived on--
en: To make sure you lived on--
ja: あなたを生かし続けるため――

key: All those years ago...
en: All those years ago...
ja: あの何年も前に……

key: This is what she asked me to do.
en: This is what she asked me to do.
ja: これが、あの人がわたしに頼んだことだから。

key: RADOMUS: She--
en: RADOMUS: She--
ja: ラドマス: 彼女が――

key: BENNETT: No harm will come to your master, Gardevoir.
en: BENNETT: No harm will come to your master, Gardevoir.
ja: ベネット: お前のマスターに危害は加えない、サーナイト。

key: You have my word.
en: You have my word.
ja: 私が約束する。

key: GARDEVOIR: You think we can believe you after everything?!
en: GARDEVOIR: You think we can believe you after everything?!
ja: サーナイト: これだけのことをしておいて、信じられるとでも思ってるの?!

key: BENNETT: He will sleep, and nothing more.
en: BENNETT: He will sleep, and nothing more.
ja: ベネット: 彼はただ眠るだけだ。それ以上は何もしない。

key: When it is over, he will wake.
en: When it is over, he will wake.
ja: すべてが終われば、目を覚ます。

key: I do not wish to see you hurt either.
en: I do not wish to see you hurt either.
ja: お前が傷つくところも見たくはない。

key: GARDEVOIR: LIAR!
en: GARDEVOIR: LIAR!
ja: サーナイト: うそつき!

key: After what you've done to Luna and \PN, and what Team Meteor intends to do after this...
en: After what you've done to Luna and \PN, and what Team Meteor intends to do after this...
ja: ルナと\PNにしたことも、この後チームメテオがやろうとしていることも知っていて……

key: You want to make allowances now!?
en: You want to make allowances now!?
ja: 今さら情けをかけようって言うの?!

key: I'll never believe that!
en: I'll never believe that!
ja: そんなの、絶対に信じない!

key: BENNETT: Tch.
en: BENNETT: Tch.
ja: ベネット: ちっ。

key: SERRA: This energy...
en: SERRA: This energy...
ja: セラ: このエネルギー……

key: LUNA: In the most dire of circumstances, it is said that Gardevoir can use all of its power to go so far as even creating a small black hole.
en: LUNA: In the most dire of circumstances, it is said that Gardevoir can use all of its power to go so far as even creating a small black hole.
ja: ルナ: 最も切迫した状況では、サーナイトは全ての力を使い、小さなブラックホールすら生み出すことができると言われています。

key: GARDEVOIR: That's right!
en: GARDEVOIR: That's right!
ja: サーナイト: その通り!

key: No matter how strong that PULSE may be, I can erase it altogether!
en: No matter how strong that PULSE may be, I can erase it altogether!
ja: あのPULSEがどれだけ強力でも、まるごと消し去ってやる!

key: BENNETT: Zero!
en: BENNETT: Zero!
ja: ベネット: ゼロ!

key: GARDEVOIR: I can set this right...
en: GARDEVOIR: I can set this right...
ja: サーナイト: これで全部、正しい形に戻せる……

key: And I will!
en: And I will!
ja: 絶対に、やってみせる!

key: BENNETT: Let Cain go; seize her before it's too late!
en: BENNETT: Let Cain go; seize her before it's too late!
ja: ベネット: カインを解放しろ、手遅れになる前にあいつを抑えろ!

key: Zel: On it!
en: Zel: On it!
ja: ゼル: やってる!

key: GARDEVOIR: Master--
en: GARDEVOIR: Master--
ja: サーナイト: マスター――

key: Whatever happens, please remember,
en: Whatever happens, please remember,
ja: 何が起きても、どうか覚えていて、

key: I will always love you more than she, or anyone else, ever could.
en: I will always love you more than she, or anyone else, ever could.
ja: わたしは、あの人よりも、他の誰よりも、ずっとあなたを愛しているの。

key: BENNETT: ZERO!
en: BENNETT: ZERO!
ja: ベネット: ゼローーー!

key: Zel: I've got it!
en: Zel: I've got it!
ja: ゼル: 捕まえた!

key: Zel: Are we too late?!
en: Zel: Are we too late?!
ja: ゼル: 遅かった?!

key: BENNETT: Her energy is spiraling out of control...
en: BENNETT: Her energy is spiraling out of control...
ja: ベネット: あいつのエネルギーが、制御を失って暴走している……

key: Everyone, get out of here!
en: Everyone, get out of here!
ja: 全員、ここから出ろ!

key: SERRA: What about \PN and the others?!
en: SERRA: What about \PN and the others?!
ja: セラ: \PNたちはどうするの?!

key: BENNETT: There's no time--
en: BENNETT: There's no time--
ja: ベネット: 時間がない――

key: Ugh, Volcarona! Go already!
en: Ugh, Volcarona! Go already!
ja: くそ、ウルガモス! さっさと行け!

key: LUNA: If you have ever walked into a class late, then you will know what it is like.
en: LUNA: If you have ever walked into a class late, then you will know what it is like.
ja: ルナ: 授業に遅れて教室に入った経験がおありなら、あの感覚がお分かりでしょう。

key: Heads turn, eyes peel,
en: Heads turn, eyes peel,
ja: みなが振り向き、目をそらさずに見つめる、

key: You think of a thousand things that they did not, but feel them all the same.
en: You think of a thousand things that they did not, but feel them all the same.
ja: あなたは、誰も考えなかったであろう千の言葉を思い浮かべながら、それでも同じ思いを感じている。

key: In that moment, you are the sole star in the sky.
en: In that moment, you are the sole star in the sky.
ja: その瞬間、あなたは空にただひとつ輝く星となる。

key: And they are trying to sleep.
en: And they are trying to sleep.
ja: そして、みなは眠ろうとしている。

key: Expectation and anxiety are frequent guests at an otherwise unplanned tea party,
en: Expectation and anxiety are frequent guests at an otherwise unplanned tea party,
ja: 期待と不安は、思いがけないお茶会の常連客のようなもの、

key: And while their sugar sits untouched, the sun is setting far too slowly.
en: And while their sugar sits untouched, the sun is setting far too slowly.
ja: 砂糖が手つかずのまま置かれる間も、太陽はあまりにもゆっくりと沈んでいく。

key: Never soon enough, it will be time for them to go along their way.
en: Never soon enough, it will be time for them to go along their way.
ja: どれだけ待っても早すぎることはなく、やがて彼らは自分の道を歩み出す時を迎える。

key: They will retire for the evening, home to their wives, to their children,
en: They will retire for the evening, home to their wives, to their children,
ja: 夜には家路につき、妻のもとへ、子供たちのもとへ、

key: Children who grow tired,
en: Children who grow tired,
ja: 疲れ果てていく子供たち、

key: Children who grow up asleep.
en: Children who grow up asleep.
ja: 眠ったまま育っていく子供たち。

key: But still, you must peel their eyes.
en: But still, you must peel their eyes.
ja: それでも、あなたは彼らの目をこじ開けなければならない。

key: There comes a time in every child's life where they must lay down their teaspoon,
en: There comes a time in every child's life where they must lay down their teaspoon,
ja: どの子供の人生にも、ティースプーンを置かねばならない時が訪れる、

key: Pinch the corners of a fabric,
en: Pinch the corners of a fabric,
ja: 布の端をつまみ、

key: And pull the tablecloth right away.
en: And pull the tablecloth right away.
ja: テーブルクロスを一気に引き抜く時が。

key: Enough,
en: Enough,
ja: もう十分、

key: She says,
en: She says,
ja: 彼女はそう言って、

key: And follows the lights out.
en: And follows the lights out.
ja: 消えゆく光のあとを追う。

key: When there is only one path, there is only one way to go.
en: When there is only one path, there is only one way to go.
ja: 道がひとつしかないなら、進む道もまたひとつしかない。

key: And when, in the darkness, the path cannot be seen at all,
en: And when, in the darkness, the path cannot be seen at all,
ja: そして、闇の中でその道すら見えなくなった時、

key: Then you are free.
en: Then you are free.
ja: その時、あなたは自由になる。

key: For now, the time has come for me to follow my own infinity.
en: For now, the time has come for me to follow my own infinity.
ja: さあ、わたしも自分自身の無限を追いかける時が来た。

key: Farewell, Mother.
en: Farewell, Mother.
ja: さようなら、お母様。

key: Farewell, Father.
en: Farewell, Father.
ja: さようなら、お父様。

key: It has been like a dream.
en: It has been like a dream.
ja: まるで夢のような時間だった。
